entry.title: New: Bill 36 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX A, PART I, DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND HUMAN CONCERNS, U.S. DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT EMERGENCY HOUSING VOUCHERS" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget Appendix A, Part I, Department of Housing and Human Concerns, to increase the appropriation for U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development Emergency Housing Vouchers by $1,200,000.
